apa-pieces-auto.title: APA Pièces Auto
apa-pieces-auto.subtitle: ERP · CRM · Point of sale
apa-pieces-auto.description: A business solution for automotive parts distribution, from point of sale to inventory management.
apa-pieces-auto.context: Professional project at NEXTIRA for the French automotive spare-parts market.
apa-pieces-auto.problem: Connect sales operations, customer relationships and stock flows in one business environment.
apa-pieces-auto.solution: React interfaces consume business PHP REST APIs connected to Dolibarr ERP/CRM classes and modules.
apa-pieces-auto.role: Full-stack development as part of the React / PHP and Dolibarr responsibilities at NEXTIRA.
features: Sales, quotations, orders and point of sale
Search, pagination, PDF generation and statistics
apa-pieces-auto.challenges: Maintain consistency between interfaces, business rules and ERP data across API exchanges.
apa-pieces-auto.learning: Connecting React interfaces to an ERP, organizing business flows and maintaining APIs.

myvioo.title: MyVioo Community
myvioo.subtitle: Backend · Communities · Events
myvioo.description: A Symfony API platform connecting communities, members and events.
myvioo.context: Final-year internship at Millesima Technologies / MyVioo, February to July 2025.
myvioo.problem: Model communities, member roles, events and their financial relationships with secure access.
myvioo.solution: A RESTful Symfony 6.4 / PHP 8.2 backend, Doctrine entities, JWT authentication and OpenAPI documentation.
myvioo.role: Secure API development, relational modeling, authentication and authorization, documentation and Docker environment.
features: Users, profiles, communities, members and owners
Events, categories, costs, services and packs
JMS / FOSRestBundle serialization, JWT and NelmioApiDoc documentation
myvioo.challenges: Structure entity relationships and maintain consistent authorization within a stateless API.
myvioo.learning: Symfony backend architecture, relational modeling, JWT security and API contract documentation.

bybuy.title: ByBuy
bybuy.subtitle: B2B · GIE · ERP / CRM
bybuy.description: An ERP developed for ByBuy to manage supplier and customer accounts for each GIE.
bybuy.context: ByBuy centralizes purchases for its members and connects economic interest groups (GIEs) with suppliers. The ERP developed for this activity is separate from ByBuy’s public website.
bybuy.problem: Each GIE needs to organize its supplier and customer accounts within its own business context.
bybuy.solution: An ERP with React interfaces and PHP APIs connected to Dolibarr and MySQL to manage supplier and customer accounts by GIE.
bybuy.role: Full-stack React / PHP contribution to the ByBuy ERP as part of the NEXTIRA projects.
features: Supplier account management for each GIE
Customer account management for each GIE
Organization of suppliers by their GIE
Organization of customers by their GIE
bybuy.challenges: Structure the relationships between GIEs, suppliers and customers so that each account belongs to the appropriate group.
bybuy.learning: Modeling accounts and their links to GIEs in a B2B ERP context.

fleet.title: Fleet

fleet.problem: Organize vehicles, availability, customers and reservations.

fleet.challenges: Represent the relationships between vehicle availability and reservation processes.
fleet.learning: Laravel architecture and business interfaces with Livewire.

wedding-invitation.title: NOUR × HASSENE
wedding-invitation.subtitle: Freelance · Creative web experience
wedding-invitation.description: An interactive wedding invitation designed as an elegant, mobile-first web experience.
wedding-invitation.context: Invitation developed in August 2026 for the September 6, 2026 event at Le Pavillon des Baies de Gammarth. Arrival and signature at 20:30, evening celebration at 21:00.
wedding-invitation.problem: Transform a traditional invitation into a personal digital event experience accessible on mobile.
wedding-invitation.solution: A light React / TypeScript / Vite interface, optimized for 9:16 and animated with GSAP.
wedding-invitation.role: Frontend design and development of the invitation experience.
features: Responsive digital invitation and subtle interactions
RSVP form: attendance, name, guest count and message
Creative prototypes: MagneticField, LivingLight, LivingBrush, BreathingSpace, GuestTrace
“ADD YOUR COLOR” concept and “See you under the lights.” easter egg
wedding-invitation.challenges: Balance expressive animations, readability and mobile comfort.
wedding-invitation.learning: Interactive experience design and frontend animation. Architecture prepared for a service such as Supabase, with no confirmed active integration.

digital-prospecting.title: Digital Prospecting Optimization
digital-prospecting.subtitle: Professional · Angular & Spring Boot
digital-prospecting.description: Angular / Spring Boot dashboard with a REST API to manage and monitor prospecting data.
digital-prospecting.context: Social Media Conseils, Tunis · June to September 2023.
digital-prospecting.problem: Improve the management and monitoring of prospecting data, as well as prospect automation and targeting.
digital-prospecting.solution: Developed an Angular / Spring Boot dashboard with a REST API and used Web Scraping to automate and target prospecting.
digital-prospecting.role: Dashboard development and prospecting automation with Data Miner, DuxSoup and PhantomBuster.
features: Prospect automation and targeting through Web Scraping
digital-prospecting.challenges: Connect the dashboard, REST API and Web Scraping tools to monitor and target prospects.
digital-prospecting.learning: Hands-on work with Angular, Spring Boot, REST APIs and Web Scraping.
